# PSTV Bridge corresponding source

This tree is BlueALSA v4.3.1 from upstream commit `f115694`, with one functional change: `a2dp_sbc_sink` advertises a maximum SBC bitpool of 20. The source-side capability remains unchanged.

The standalone delta is also available at `../../patches/bluez-alsa-v4.3.1-pstv-bitpool20.patch`.
